title: Veltro Source Index
description: Sidecar that says where each type of the model is declared in the source. Deliberately NOT part of the model: a '.vel' carries no source locations, so only an extractor (which has the source in front of it) can know them, and keeping them out of the '.vel' keeps the token cost of reading a whole architecture at zero. It is a derived, checkout-specific build artefact: regenerate it, never commit it, since line numbers move with the first edit and a stale index pointing at the wrong line is worse than no index at all

root.description: The directory every 'file' is relative to, as an absolute POSIX-style path. A consumer may override it when the project has moved

locations.description: Model node id -> every place that type is declared. It is a LIST because one type can legitimately be declared in several files (C# 'partial class', TypeScript interface merging), which the parser merges into a single node

end_line.description: 1-based line the declaration ends on, so a tool can read the whole type without guessing where it stops
